gaps.sentence: 'Leave the building immediately!' the firefighter ordered. The firefighter ordered us ___ the building immediately.
gaps.explanation: Orders are reported with order + object + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'I've lost my keys,' she admitted. She admitted that she ___ her keys.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect backshifts to past perfect: have lost → had lost.

gaps.sentence: 'OK, I'll help you move house,' she said. She ___ to help me move house.
gaps.explanation: Agreement to a request is reported as agreed to do something.

gaps.sentence: 'Why did you cancel the order?' he asked. He asked why I ___ the order.
gaps.explanation: Wh-questions keep the wh-word but drop do-support and backshift: did you cancel → I had cancelled.

gaps.sentence: 'Please don't smoke in here,' the host said. The host asked me ___ in there.
gaps.explanation: Negative requests: asked me not to smoke; 'here' shifts to 'there'.

gaps.sentence: 'Let's walk to the launch instead of driving,' he said. He ___ to the launch instead of driving.
gaps.explanation: 'Suggest' takes a gerund, never a to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'Have you seen my reading glasses?' he asked. He asked ___ his reading glasses.
gaps.explanation: 'If/whether' reports a yes/no question; the tense backshifts to past perfect.

gaps.sentence: 'Someone has stolen my bike,' he cried. He cried that someone ___ his bike.
gaps.explanation: have stolen backshifts to had stolen after the past reporting verb 'cried'.
